xrefdescription.para: Verify that foreach() works with a function pointer
Verify that init() succeeds and the heap starts empty
Verify that init() returns an error when capacity is zero
Verify that init() works for a max-heap
Verify that init() works with a lambda comparator
Verify that init() with growth disabled sets is_full correctly
Verify that pushing a single element makes it the root of a min-heap
Verify that the min-heap root is always the smallest element
Verify that the max-heap root is always the largest element
Verify that push() increments size correctly
Verify that push() returns false when growth is disabled and heap is full
Verify that push() triggers growth and succeeds when growth is enabled
Verify that push() maintains the min-heap property after many insertions
Verify that push() maintains the max-heap property after many insertions
Verify that push() works for float values
Verify push() with duplicate values maintains heap property
Verify that pop() on an empty heap returns an error
Verify that pop() on a single-element heap leaves it empty
Verify that pop() returns the min-heap root and decrements size
Verify that pop() returns the max-heap root correctly
Verify that successive pop() calls return elements in sorted order for a min-heap
Verify that successive pop() calls return elements in sorted order for a max-heap
Verify that pop() restores the heap property after removal
Verify that peek() returns the root without removing it
Verify that peek() on an empty heap returns an error
Verify that multiple peek() calls return the same root
Verify that copy() produces an independent deep copy
Verify that copy() preserves the heap property in the copy
Verify that the single-argument copy() uses the source's own allocator
Verify that foreach() visits every element exactly once
Verify that foreach() returns false on an empty heap
Verify that size() tracks pushes and pops correctly
Verify that is_empty() returns true on a fresh heap and false after push
Verify that capacity() returns a value >= the requested initial capacity
Verify that is_full() is false when growth is enabled
Verify that a lambda comparator correctly implements a min-heap of Task structs by priority
Verify that popping all Task elements returns them in priority order
